attchmntText: IGL Spirits Limited has informed the Exchange regarding 'Outcome of Board Meeting'.
voiceSummary: IGL Spirits Limited announced the Board approved Unaudited Financial Results for the quarter and half year ended 30th September, 2026. The Board meeting was held on 12th November, 2026. Revenue from operations for the quarter ended 30th September, 2026, was Rs. 2,295.41 Crores. Profit before tax for the quarter was Rs. 82.80 Crores. Profit for the period was Rs. 61.20 Crores. Earnings per share was Rs. 9.13. For the half year ended 30th September, 2026, revenue from operations was Rs. 4,837.30 Crores. Profit before tax was Rs. 162.66 Crores. Profit for the period was Rs. 120.79 Crores. Earnings per share was Rs. 18.02. The results include a Limited Review Report by joint statutory auditors. The financials reflect the demerger of India Glycols Limited spirits and biofuel undertaking effective 1st April, 2026.

attchmntText: IGL Spirits Limited has informed the Exchange regarding the Amendment to AOA/MOA of the company.
voiceSummary: IGL Spirits Limited announced that its Board of Directors approved the adoption of a new set of Articles of Association on 12th November 2026. The meeting commenced at 15.45 Hrs and concluded at 17.20 Hrs. The adoption aims to align the Articles with the Securities Contracts Regulation Rules 1957 and the group's governance framework. This change is subject to shareholder approval and any required regulatory or statutory approvals. The disclosure is made under Regulation 30 of SEBI Listing Regulations.

attchmntText: IGL Spirits Limited has informed the Exchange about change in Management
voiceSummary: IGL Spirits Limited designated five individuals as Senior Management Personnel effective 12th November 2026. The Board of Directors made these appointments on the recommendation of the Nomination and Remuneration Committee. The designated personnel are Shri Shashi Kant Shukla as Business Head Liquor, Shri Shailendra Kumar Pandey as Head Distillery Gorakhpur, Shri Sunit Kapila as Head Bottling and Distillery Kashipur, Shri Anish Arora as Head Logistics, and Shri Vishal Shishodia as Head IMFL. The Board Meeting commenced at 15.45 Hrs and concluded at 17.20 Hrs on 12th November 2026. Details regarding these appointments are available on the company website at www.iglspirits.com.
